body:
```suggestion
				You can optionally specify names of variables that may appear in the expression with [param input_names], so that you can bind them when it gets executed. Use [param allowed_scope] to limit the set of functions available in the expression.
```

Instead of being a parse error, I think it should just not parse as a builtin func and instead continue below to become TK_IDENTIFIER.
This way it acts as if it doesn't exist and users can override it.

I think this could be a property instead of a new parameter, it's only being set here.
I don't think it would change each parse often so this way users could just set it once when the expression is created instead of passing it each time. Like how SpinBox calls parse twice.
And there would be no need for a compatibility method.
There shouldn't be an issue even if it is set after parse either since it is checked in execute.
